name: Library Wing (Tyr's Hand)
summary: In the Library Wing of Tyr's Hand, Scarlet Crusaders guard their books and relics. The secluded hall lies within the order's fortified redoubt in the Eastern Plaguelands. Crusaders gather there to study scripture and keep watch over the sanctum.

sections.title: Sanctum of Zealous Lore
sections.body:
Off the abbey's central nave and opposite the martial quarters, the Library Wing holds the Scarlet Crusade's religious writings. Priests and crusaders study theology, militant doctrine, and works shaped by years of war against the Scourge.

These books do not preserve open scholarship. They feed the Crusade's suspicion and its belief that every outsider bears corruption.

sections.title: Vessels of the Light
sections.body: The Scarlet priesthood guards the library's scrolls and scriptures. To reach its back rooms, you must fight through elite Scarlet defenders. They protect the library as both a bastion of faith and a fortress.

faq.q: Where is the Library Wing located?
aliases: how to find library wing tyr's hand
faq.answer: The Library Wing lies inside Tyr's Hand Abbey, in the Scarlet Crusade enclave of Tyr's Hand in the southeastern Eastern Plaguelands. Within the abbey, it is south of the main entrance hall and opposite the Hall of Arms.

faq.q: What kinds of books are kept here?
aliases: what books are in the library
what is stored in the library wing
faq.answer: The shelves hold theology devoted to the Holy Light, militant doctrines, and Scarlet Crusade writings meant to justify its endless crusade against the undead and outsiders.

faq.q: Who controls this part of the abbey?
aliases: who is in the library wing
faq.answer: Elite Scarlet Crusade forces control the Library Wing. Clerics, scholars, and heavily armed defenders guard its doctrinal texts and sanctified supplies.

faq.q: Is the Library Wing dangerous to visit?
faq.answer: Yes. The Library Wing lies deep within Tyr's Hand, a Scarlet Crusade stronghold where its zealous defenders attack trespassers on sight.

angles.text: As a priest, you can see how the Library Wing turns divine contemplation toward narrow-minded extremism and paranoia.
As a paladin, you may see the Library Wing as a perversion of the Silver Hand's scholarly traditions, where devotion to the Light has given way to militant zealotry.
